subsystems.name: Command interface
subsystems.description: Bootstraps Cobra and prepares the start request.

subsystems.name: Application orchestration
subsystems.description: Constructs the app and coordinates VM and runtime startup.

subsystems.name: Virtual machine
subsystems.description: Creates and starts Lima while preserving the QEMU/VZ choice.

subsystems.name: Runtime backends
subsystems.description: Resolves registered container implementations and invokes their lifecycle methods.

components.name: CLI bootstrap
components.description: Enters the root command and delegates command selection to Cobra.

components.name: Start command and config
components.description: Registers start callbacks and merges CLI/config values before execution.

components.name: Application construction
components.description: Builds the concrete Colima app around a Lima-backed guest.

components.name: Startup coordinator
components.description: Creates runtime environments, starts the VM, then invokes runtime lifecycle methods.

components.name: Lima lifecycle
components.description: Owns Lima construction and the fresh-profile start command chain.

components.name: VM driver configuration
components.description: Defaults to QEMU and conditionally selects VZ when platform and architecture permit it.

components.name: Runtime registry
components.description: Looks up a runtime factory by configured name; the selected map target is intentionally unresolved.

components.name: Docker runtime
components.description: One registered implementation for provisioning and starting Docker.

components.name: Containerd runtime
components.description: One registered implementation for provisioning and starting containerd/buildkit.

components.name: Kubernetes extension
components.description: An optional registered runtime appended after the configured base runtime.
